purpose: After-the-fact source audit of actual deferred-add order notional against the complete native OKX 1m quote turnover at each actual add entry hour.
single_variable: Observed historical quote turnover in the 60-second bar opened at each actual added-order hour, after the order event, compared with that arm's actual_notional.

source_method.price_bars: Existing OKX-native 1m archive/API helper, requiring 60 contiguous confirmed minute bars whose aggregate OHLC exactly matches the frozen H1.
source_method.volume_bars: Native USDT-SWAP quote/base volume from the same daily archive where available; official OKX history-candles API fallback must reproduce minute OHLC and archive volume where present.

interpretation: Ex-post diagnostic only. Full-minute quote turnover includes trades after the modeled entry and is not order-book depth or a guaranteed execution capacity. No source volume is used to select, size, or reject orders. Account arms are separate hypotheticals and are not summed as simultaneous flow.
actual_order_units: Input ledgers retain actual_notional but not raw native units or individual subslot prices. Reported notional/turnover is an exact USDT comparison; open-implied base units are explicitly an approximation.
fees_or_funding: No new fee, funding, or order simulation; source audit only.
